title: Identification of Unique Key miRNAs, TFs, and mRNAs in Virulent MTB Infection Macrophages by Network Analysis.
authors: Zhu, Tingting; Liu, Han; Su, Li; Dawood, Ali; Hu, Changmin; Chen, Xi; Chen, Huanchun; Chen, Yingyu; Guo, Aizhen
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA测序和网络分析识别结核分枝杆菌感染巨噬细胞中的miRNA、TF和mRNA调控轴，但仅涉及TF作为网络节点，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心关联弱。
abstract: Although Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) has existed for thousands of years, its immune escape mechanism remains obscure. Increasing evidence signifies that microRNAs (miRNAs) play pivotal roles in the progression of tuberculosis (TB). RNA sequencing was used to sequence miRNAs in human acute monocytic leukemia cells (THP-1) infected by the virulent MTB-1458 strain and the avirulent vaccine strain Mycobacterium bovis Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG). Sets of differentially expressed miRNAs (DE-miRNAs) between MTB-1458/BCG-infected groups and uninfected groups were identified, among which 18 were differentially expressed only in the MTB-1458-infected THP-1 group. Then, 13 transcription factors (TFs) and 81 target genes of these 18 DE-miRNAs were matched. Gene Ontology classification as well as Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway enrichment analysis showed that the candidate targets were predominantly involved in apoptotic-associated and interferon-gamma-mediated signaling pathways. A TF-miRNA-mRNA interaction network was constructed to analyze the relationships among these 18 DE-miRNAs and their targets and TFs, as well as display the hub miRNAs, TFs, and target genes. Considering the degrees from network analysis and the reported functions, this study focused on the BHLHE40-miR-378d-BHLHE40 regulation axis and confirmed that BHLHE40 was a target of miR-378d. This cross-talk among DE-miRNAs, mRNAs, and TFs might be an important feature in TB, and the findings merited further study and provided new insights into immune defense and evasion underlying host-pathogen interactions.
abstract_zh: 尽管结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis, MTB）已存在数千年，其免疫逃逸机制仍不明确。越来越多的证据表明，微小RNA（miRNAs）在结核病（tuberculosis, TB）的进展中发挥关键作用。本研究采用RNA测序技术，对感染强毒MTB-1458株及无毒疫苗株牛分枝杆菌卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guerin, BCG）的人急性单核细胞白血病细胞（THP-1）中的miRNAs进行测序。鉴定了MTB-1458/BCG感染组与未感染组之间差异表达的miRNAs（DE-miRNAs）集合，其中18个仅在MTB-1458感染的THP-1组中差异表达。随后，匹配到这18个DE-miRNAs的13个转录因子（TFs）和81个靶基因。基因本体分类及京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析显示，候选靶标主要涉及凋亡相关及干扰素-γ介导的信号通路。构建了TF-miRNA-mRNA相互作用网络，以分析这18个DE-miRNAs与其靶基因及TFs之间的关系，并展示枢纽miRNAs、TFs和靶基因。基于网络分析中的度值及已报道功能，本研究聚焦于BHLHE40-miR-378d-BHLHE40调控轴，并确认BHLHE40是miR-378d的靶标。DE-miRNAs、mRNAs和TFs之间的这种交叉对话可能是结核病的重要特征，这些发现值得进一步研究，并为宿主-病原体相互作用中的免疫防御与逃逸提供了新见解。
